page.layout: One column of Syriac text, set in full lines, with a short last line at the foot of the block. No running head, no margin notes printed. Page number at the top right.
page.notes: The whole page is Syriac (Estrangela/Serto-type hand), not Latin, Greek or Hebrew. I could not read the Syriac letters reliably enough to copy them, so the lines are marked illegible rather than guessed. The line count is about 14 full lines plus a short final line; the paragraph divisions are not certain and are shown only as a single paragraph per line group. Someone who reads Syriac should check this page against the scan. The left edge shows a scan border and show-through, which are left out.
